title: Mattel Hot Wheels 1998 First Editions '32 FORD #7 Of 40 Cars Collectors Model
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The Mattel Hot Wheels 1998 First Editions '32 FORD is a highly sought-after collectible car model that is part of a series of diecast vehicles made by Mattel. This specific car, number 7 out of 40, features a detailed design of a Ford vehicle in a 1:64 scale. As a part of the Cars character family, this model appeals to both toy and car enthusiasts alike, making it a valuable addition to any collection.
